subject: Lena DeJohn Tomaso Band Room Naming
overview: The committee approved naming the high school band room after former member Lena DeJohn Tomaso and ratified a new multi-year contract for paraprofessionals. Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent presented her initial entry plan, and the body received updates on school infrastructure projects and the opening of the student-run Bistro 489.

items.title: Minutes Amendment
items.summary: Approved the minutes as amended to correct the estimated cost of air compressors.

items.title: Financial Approvals
items.summary: Approved various bills, fund transfers, and payrolls for the district.

items.title: Secretary's Report
items.summary: Accepted updates on a yearbook supplement for the Class of 2018, repairs to the Columbus School slide, and a new Elks scholarship program.

items.title: Band Room Naming
items.summary: Voted to name the high school band room in honor of former committee member Lena DeJohn Tomaso for her 28 years of service.

items.title: Liquor Licenses
items.summary: Approved one-day liquor licenses for a retirement party and a community fundraiser at the high school's Bistro 489.

items.title: PTO Registration Policy
items.summary: Discussed implementing a mandatory online registration and financial oversight policy for PTOs and booster organizations.

items.title: Roberts Playground Update
items.summary: Received a progress report on vendor selection and the five-week timeline for the playground's renovation and surface installation.

items.title: Superintendent's Entry Plan
items.summary: Accepted Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent's 'Listen, Learn, and Lead' roadmap detailing her strategy through early 2019.

items.title: Donation Recognition
items.summary: Acknowledged the donation of over 100 backpacks from Agero and literacy materials provided by the Kiwanis Club.

items.title: Sixth Grade Enrollment
items.summary: Confirmed that all 17 students selected in the McGlynn School lottery remained enrolled in the district.

items.title: Bistro 489 Opening
items.summary: Announced the October 3 public opening of the high school's student-run restaurant.

items.title: Lesley University Partnership
items.summary: Referred a report on academic collaboration and math instruction support from Lesley University to the Curriculum Subcommittee.

items.title: Paraprofessional MOA
items.summary: Ratified the collective bargaining agreement for district paraprofessionals for the 2019-2021 period.

items.title: Resolutions and New Business
items.summary: Honored former coach Richard Chaney and announced a citywide collection for victims of the Merrimack Valley gas explosions.
